name: Guang yu Ying zhi Lian
source:
Players experience the story through the eyes of Chu Hebai, a woman who has lived overseas for many years and suffers from psychogenic blindness caused by psychological trauma.

Her return to her long-abandoned homeland is triggered by a funeral—a journey that brings her face to face with a past she has avoided, a web of complicated family ties, and—

a presence known as the "Lamplighter," who has always stayed by her side.

When reality becomes too blinding, the mind chooses to veil the world.

When memories grow too heavy to bear, consciousness creates its own "light."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4412960/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
玩家通过楚河白的眼睛来体验故事，楚河白是一位旅居海外多年、因心理创伤而患有心因性失明的女性。

她回到被遗弃已久的故乡是由一场葬礼引发的——这次旅程让她面对她一直回避的过去、一张复杂的家庭关系网，以及——

一直陪伴在她身边的被称为“点灯人”的存在。

当现实变得过于盲目时，心灵就会选择掩盖世界。

当记忆变得太重而难以承受时，意识就会创造自己的“光”。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4412960/]Steam[/url]]
